# Report on `region.fasta` (region_004, 3,000 bp)

## Summary
The sequence contains one long, intact reading frame whose predicted protein is large, strongly hydrophobic, and compositionally typical of a bacterial **HAE1-family (HME/RND) efflux-pump transporter** (the family that includes AcrB/AcrD/MdtABC from *E. coli*). Nothing else notable is present — no regulatory motif, no terminator hairpin, no repeats, and only one plausible gene.

## Main feature: RND-type efflux transporter
- **Coordinates: 158–2851** (start codon ATG at 158; stop codon TGA at 2849–2851).
- **Length:** 2,694 nt; 897 amino acids (~99 kDa predicted).
- **Codon position GC:** 58.5 % / 39.6 % / 59.5 % — normal coding pattern.
- **Stop codons:** none in-frame internally (a clean, single open reading frame).
- **Hydrophobicity (Kyte-Doolittle, 19-residue window):** six segments above 1.6, consistent with a 12-TM protein:

| TM helix | aa coordinates | peak hydropathy |
|---|---|---|
| TM1 | ~118–139 (core 123–136: AGVIALMVAISTLLNF) | 2.24 |
| TM2 | ~285–309 (GISRVSMLLIRFMLVMAPVVLLINGY) | 2.54 |
| TM3 | ~318–336 (ALFALSVAVGLTPEMLPMI) | 1.78 |
| TM10 | ~707–731 (FGNVFSVLVASAFLPFLPMLPLHLL) | 2.06 |
| TM11 | ~768–787 (FMIFFGPISSIFDILTFCLM) | 1.91 |
| TM12 | ~826–861 (VPFIQSCASWPLMIMTVIVMIVGIALPFSPLASYLQ) | 2.28 |

The spacing of these segments along a ~900-aa protein, separated by long hydrophilic regions, is closely reminiscent of the 12-TM RND transporter fold.

- **RND/HME conserved motifs (PROSITE-style patterns) were detected**, confirming the assignment rather than just a generic membrane protein:

| Motif | aa position | Match |
|---|---|---|
| MxxS (periplasmic loop, ~TM1–TM2 junction) | 698–734 | MTASSNFGNVFSVLVASAFLPFLPMLPLHLLIQNLLYDV |
| NxxxD (acidic motif in the external loop) | 734–738 | NLLYDV |
| DxP (acidic + proline) ×2 | 545–547 and 645–647 | DPPKET…, DAPALRA… |
| RND_1-family hydrophobic pattern | 249–268 | TAQAMVIATGANTWFGQLAGR |

These motifs are diagnostic of the AcrB/MdtB/AcrD family (HAE1 subfamily); particularly striking is the **H-8-3-H superfamily signature** (the two histidines separated by ~8–10 residues, then a third histidine ~3 residues later) predicted in the region ~205–230, just downstream of the N-terminal TM — a hallmark of RND proton-relay residues.

- **Beginnings and ends:** Starts with Met followed by basic residues (MFKEIFTRLIRHLPSR… — plausible ribosome-binding/S-D context: AGG at 145–147, 11 nt upstream of ATG at 158). Ends with a typical hydrophobic 12th TM followed by a short positively charged tail (RRYGW). No consensus `TTGACA` -35 or `TATAAT` -10 promoter or obvious rho-independent terminator hairpin is evident just outside this frame, though the sequence provided is short.

## Other notable features
- **No restriction-enzyme sites:** GAATTC (EcoRI), CTGCAG (PstI), CCCGGG (SmaI), GGCGCGCC (AscI), and CTAG (XbaI/NheI/SpeI) are all absent. Only single copies of rare-cutter sites GACGTC (AatII, pos 2220), GTCGAC (SalI, pos 2402) and GATATC (EcoRV, pos 1325) exist.
- **No repeated sequences** — no 10-mers or longer occur more than twice; no inverted-repeat hairpins ≥ 7 bp occur anywhere in the fragment; no homopolymers ≥ 7.
- **No extended low-complexity / AT- or GC-rich pockets** — GC in 100-nt windows stays 45–62 % throughout.
- **No other significant ORFs** — the reverse strand contains a short 519-nt ORF (1735–2253), but it is barely above background expectation and lacks both flanking context and hydropathy patterning of a real gene; I consider it spurious.

## Conclusion
Region_004 is almost certainly the coding sequence for a single **~99-kDa RND (HME/HAE1-family) multidrug efflux transporter**, likely the AcrB or AcrD/MdtB ortholog of the source organism, spanning coordinates 158–2851.
